name: Quay sticky rice
summary: Xôi on the Ninh Kiều quay is the snack row the Can Tho Portal of 4 January 2016 describes from about 16:00: xôi bắp, xôi đậu phộng, and xôi trắng, with barbecue, bánh xèo, bread, and sweet potato.
origin: Bến Ninh Kiều, on the 2016 Can Tho Portal.
howToEat: On the spot, or on a bench in the park, from about 16:00 to 19:00 on that account.
where: The road to Bến Ninh Kiều.
seoTitle: Xoi on the Ninh Kieu quay
seoDescription: Xôi bắp, xôi đậu phộng, and xôi trắng on the Ninh Kiều quay from about 16:00 to 19:00, on the 2016 Can Tho Portal.
